newsitem.title: POLAND: Animex to invest PLN 200 mln in 3 years.
newsitem.headline: Animex to invest PLN 200 mln in 3 years.

text.p: Polish food producer and trader Animex SA plans to invest 200 million zlotys in modernisation and acquisitions in the next three years and expects its planned share issue to provide half of the sum, the firm's head said.

"We want to earmark about 200 million zlotys for investments from 1997 to 1999 and...half of the investments will be financed from our own funds and the remaining half from the issue," Animex president Witold Pereta told a news conference.
Animex shareholders will vote on the new issue of 10 million shares ex rights ot an extraordinary shareholders meeting on April 18.
Pereta said the shares were likely to be issued in early or mid-July.
The issue will be directed mainly to selected institutional, mostly foreign investors, said Ryszard Jach of IB Austria Securities brokerage, which is offering the shares.
"A part of the issue would be directed to about 250 investors..., private, medium-term and long-term investors," Jach said.
Pereta said the company planned to buy at least two meat processing plants in 1997 for a total of 54 million zlotys.

It wanted to spend another 50 million zlotys to purchase three cold storage centres and plants producing meat wrappings, he said. He added the remaining funds would invested in modernising its current plants.
